facts.fact: The national social registry coordinator said the AOUN cash transfers will be paid under a partnership agreement between Taazour, the Caisse de Depot et de Developpement and GIMTEL, with beneficiaries from the registry notified electronically and paid to the number they choose.

note: Facts dated by the document's published date; the document gives the cash leg in future tense. Registry holds 352,000 households per the coordinator.
